Priya Nair: Drafting internal release note for rollout v2026.04.1 — aiming for canary 14:40 PT, broad rollout 15:10 PT. Draft lives at https://redwood.internal/rn/drafts/2026-04-1
Caleb Morris (Infra): Please include model pin and commit SHA so infra can wire traffic pins and autoscaler targets. Also request a clear rollback threshold.
Priya Nair: Proposed pins: model_bundle=rbw-mix-0401, commit=9b2c4f0, runtime=snap-384. Adding to draft now.
Jo Park (Docs): I can trim copy for the team blast. Keep it 2 bullets + one-line oncall. Who's owning oncall?
Ravi Shah (Oncall): I'm covering 13:00-17:00 PT. I'll take canary monitoring and has authority to rollback if triggers fire.
Caleb Morris: Ops rollback triggers suggestion:
```
rollback_triggers:
  - p50_latency_ms: 420
  - error_rate_delta_pct: 0.7
  - kv_cache_miss_pct: 4.0
```
Fallback model: rbw-mix-0330. Runbook: /runbooks/RBW-MIX-ROLLBACK-2026.
Priya Nair: Good. Also note: load test shows slight tail latency on 2 long sequences; include mixed-length canary samples (20% long).
DocsBot: Quick style tip: use "Canary: 14:40 PT — Rollout: 15:10 PT" in the first line to increase scannability.
Jo Park (Docs): Draft blurb for blast (Priya please confirm):
"Internal: Rolling out v2026.04.1. Canary 14:40 PT, rollout 15:10 PT. Model pinned to rbw-mix-0401 (commit 9b2c4f0). Rollback if p50>420ms, error rate +0.7% or KV cache miss >4%. Oncall: Ravi Shah. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/RBW-MIX-ROLLBACK-2026."
Priya Nair: LGTM. I'll add the exact pin metadata block in the draft for ops: `model_bundle: rbw-mix-0401`, `commit: 9b2c4f0`, `runtime-config: snap-384`, `pinned_at: 2026-04-01T13:30:00Z`.
Caleb Morris: Ops checklist appended to runbook: preflight queries, KV cache prewarm, autoscaler target sanity check, smoke prompts (short/mid/long).
Ravi Shah: I'll execute checklist at 14:20 PT and update here. Standby for canary.
DeployBot: [deploybot] Canary scheduled: staging -> prod-canary at 2026-04-01T14:40:00-07:00 (requested by Priya Nair). Reminder set for 15 minutes prior.
Jo Park (Docs): Posting preview now: https://redwood.internal/rn/previews/2026-04-1 1. Will publish internal blast at 14:25 PT unless we see objections.
Priya Nair: Sending final pin block to docs in 5. Thanks all.
Ravi Shah: Preflight complete: autoscaler OK, KV warmed, smoke prompts pass. No OOMs. Standing by 14:30 PT.
Jo Park (Docs): Published internal blast at 14:25 PT. Included oncall rota and runbook link.
DeployBot: [deploybot] Reminder set: Canary at 2026-04-01T14:25:00-07:00.
Priya Nair: Will update this thread with deploy status once canary ends. :white_check_mark:
